bds.h: Silicon Valley leaders call for reinstatement of Nvidia CEO with 'Stand With Jensen' petition
bds.lede: A petition calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO is drawing support from prominent Silicon Valley personalities, four days after his resignation stemming from revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.
rows: BBC News
A number of tech figures want the board of the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
CBC News

A petition calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO is drawing support from prominent Silicon Valley personalities, four days after his resignation stemming from revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.
CBS News
Nvidia's board isn't considering rehiring Jensen Huang as CEO despite an online petition that has drawn more than 180,000 signatures.
The Guardian
As tech industry pushes for return, US president says he thinks Huang ‘learned a big lesson’
Al Jazeera
Nvidia faces a potential 30 percent value loss in value without Jensen Huang, market analysts say, amid a stock downturn.
CP24

U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday he would not mind seeing Jensen Huang return as chief executive officer of Nvidia, adding his voice to calls for Huang’s reinstatement after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy forced him out.

bds.h: Lindsay Clancy will be retried in March for the killing of her 3 children
bds.lede: Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose highly divisive murder trial shone a global spotlight on postpartum mental health, will be tried again on murder charges for the killings of her three children.
rows: BBC News
The 36-year-old's first trial this year fell apart when a 12-person jury failed to reach a verdict.
CBC News

Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose highly divisive murder trial shone a global spotlight on postpartum mental health, will be tried again on murder charges for the killings of her three children.
CBS News
Prosecutors plan to retry Lindsay Clancy on first-degree murder charges, after her first Massachusetts murder trial ended in a mistrial.
Toronto Star
PLYMOUTH, Mass. (AP) — A Massachusetts judge on Monday scheduled Lindsay Clancy’s retrial for late March after prosecutors signaled that — at least for now — they intend to prosecute
NBC News

Lindsay Clancy will be tried for the second time for the killing of her three children in 2023. Clancy's first trial ended in a mistrial. NBC News’ Steven Romo and Danny Cevallos detail the next steps in this high-profile case.
